criteria.description: Foundation contracts and deterministic validation are present
The standalone ADDER skill portfolio is present
Agent authority and recovery boundaries are documented and tested
Advisory GitLab artifacts can be generated locally
The planned three-repository operational cohort is complete
Human-validated accuracy and operational metrics are available
AI-assistance provenance has been demonstrated with approved evidence
Package trust checks use approved authoritative sources
Remediation and recovery have been exercised on a real repository
Operational and control owners are assigned
Exception and support procedures are approved
License and redistribution terms are approved
Target runner and platform compatibility is verified
Version signing and release integrity are approved
AppSec and Delivery Enablement approve blocking controls

blocking_conditions: Record human adjudication and accuracy metrics
Assign operational, policy, exception, support, and release owners
Approve licensing, distribution, compatibility, and release-integrity controls
Obtain explicit approval before any mandatory enforcement
allowed_use: Development and validation of candidate controls
prohibited_use: Mandatory merge, build, deployment, or release enforcement
Autonomous code changes, merges, deployments, or exception approvals
Enterprise-wide assurance or complete provenance claims
External redistribution before licensing and release approval
limitations: One of three planned operational repositories has been assessed
Only the local macOS and Python environment has been exercised
No live GitLab pipeline was run
